content:
# “Make a lot of mistakes,” Steve Jobs interview with Michael Mortiz, 1984

**Source**: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_rHwACvY3vA

**Transcribed**: 2025-12-26 16:17

---

**[Speaker 1]**: Things get more refined as you make mistakes and do them. So I've had a chance to make a lot of mistakes. Your aesthetics get better as you make mistakes.

But a real big thing is, the way I've always felt is that if you're going to make something, it doesn't take any more energy and rarely does it take more money to make it really great. All it takes is is is a little more time, uh, not that much more. And uh, a willingness to do so, a willingness to perseverance till it's really great.
